name: F-16
_about: An F-16 style HUD filling the visible window (x 120..680, y 100..380) in HUD green, one effect layer (shared/widgets/f16): the airspeed tape on the left is the car's speed (0..260 km/h or 0..160 mph, its box the speed in digits), the altitude tape on the right the rpm / 10 (0..700, its box likewise), the pitch ladder and the horizon line between them, the flight path vector, the bank angle scale under it, and the heading tape at the top (navigation's heading). The pitch and bank are the road's gradient and camber (chassis.VehicleModel LaneSlope) plus the g's, the body squatting or diving and banking into turns as a jet. The tapes run the full height; BMW's speed and limit sign (x 150..355, y 314..378) draws over the airspeed tape's lower part. The bank scale sits at the bottom. During route guidance or driver assistance it draws nothing, so BMW's HUD shows.
